UAObjectType.Description: Aber Futura Connect Xtra: one device with Probe, FUTURA and SPECTRA components and two FunctionalUnits
FUTURA functional unit: capacitance, conductivity, biomass, temperatures, commands and ProgramManager

Status bit 4: clean leakage (severity 300)
Status bit 7: probe memory, file missing (severity 600)
Status bit 9: no probe (severity 600); measurements get Bad_SensorFailure

Status bit 1: conductivity out of range (severity 300)
Status bit 6: FUTURA memory, file missing (severity 600)
Status bit 12: Cole-Cole curve fit error (severity 300)
